subject: Env Readyplay: MAP to close — API token schedule, org seed, IP allowlist & peering ops
messages:
From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: elena.soto@clearsight.ai, it@clearsight.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Env Readyplay: MAP to close — API token schedule, org seed, IP allowlist & peering ops

Hi Elena / ClearSight IT team —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our mutual action plan (MAP) conversation, I want to confirm the engineering prerequisites we need to provision the POC environment and a tight-close timeline so both sides can hit the end-of-month target. Below are the items Redwood needs and suggested owners / dates.

High-level ask: Can you confirm availability to complete the items in the schedule below? If a date is not possible, please propose alternatives so we can update the MAP.

1) Org & access
- Redwood needs an org admin to accept the invite we send (Admin-level user or SSO service account). Owner: ClearSight IT. Target: 2026-12-14

2) API keys / token scope
- We will issue a scoped POC API token (read+generation limited to test models). Please confirm any internal token rotation policy that would invalidate tokens during the POC. Owner: ClearSight security. Target: 2026-12-15

3) IP allowlist / firewall
- Provide CIDR ranges (at least one public egress IP per region). Recommended: primary /28 for Redwood egress. Owner: ClearSight IT. Target: 2026-12-18

4) VPC peering / connectivity
- If you want VPC peering, we need: BGP ASN (or static routes), desired peering subnet(s), and proposed maintenance window. Owner: ClearSight network. Target: 2026-12-22

5) Validation & smoke tests
- Post-provisioning, Redwood will run a 48-hour smoke validation (latency + auth). Target verification window: 2026-12-26 to 2026-12-28

Close target: 2026-12-30 (final acceptance and commercial close).

Attachments: MAP_Clearsight_v1.xlsx (action-table), network-diagram.pdf (suggested peering topology). I've also uploaded a copy to the Drive link in the MAP.

Please confirm owners and the CIDR/BGP details you can share. If you prefer not to do peering, we can proceed with IP allowlist and NAT traversal; either path works for the POC but peering shortens latency and gives better throughput.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Ben — this layout is helpful.

We can own org acceptance (I will accept once you send the invite). A few clarifying items from our side:
- Token scope: we need the token to be limited to the "poc-project" and it must be rotatable without breaking the staging app — what's your recommended rotation cadence for short-lived tokens?
- IP allowlist: we can provide two /28 ranges. I'll confirm exact CIDRs by EOD Monday (2026-12-14).
- VPC peering: looping in Mike Chen (network) — Mike, can you share our ASN and any peering template you prefer?

We prefer a 12/28 verification window; meeting your 12/30 close looks feasible if the peering is completed by 12/22 as suggested.

Elena Soto
Head of Integrations
ClearSight AI
elena.soto@clearsight.ai

Elena / Mike — thanks for the quick turn. Per our last call I created a concise action table with owners and the MAP dates below and uploaded it to the Drive folder (link included in metadata). I also prepared a DocuSign packet for the POC SOW that covers responsibilities during the POC; attaching the PDF for your legal to preview.

Mutual action items (owner / target):
- Org invite accepted (ClearSight Admin) / 2026-12-14 / action: I will send invite by EOD today.
- Token issuance & rotation guidance (Redwood issues scoped token) / 2026-12-15 / action: Redwood to create token, request that you confirm rotation policy that won't break the POC.
- Provide IP allowlist CIDRs (ClearSight IT) / 2026-12-18 / action: provide two public /28s + any internal egress mapping.
- VPC peering details (ClearSight Network) / 2026-12-20 / action: provide ASN, preferred CIDR, maintenance window. Redwood to provision from our side 12/21-12/22.
- Smoke tests & KPI check (Redwood + ClearSight) / 2026-12-26 to 2026-12-28 / action: run baseline perf and auth checks.
- Final acceptance & close (Commercial) / 2026-12-30 / action: sign-off in HubSpot & finalize billing terms

Resources attached: MAP_Clearsight_v1.xlsx (action table) — I moved the most recent copy to the Drive folder. DocuSign packet: docusign_map.pdf for legal review. network-diagram.pdf shows the suggested peering flow (public egress + optional peering).

If Mike can share a preferred peering template (or the ASN) I will feed that to our infra team. Otherwise we can fall back to IP allowlist-only and still complete the POC on the proposed timeline.

Thanks — I will send the org invite now.

Ben

Quick internal note for scheduling the peering repair/maintenance window and configuration details — copying into the thread for visibility.

Neha (Infra) observations / ask:
- CIDR overlap: please confirm ClearSight's internal subnets. We require no overlap with our peering subnets (recommended Redwood peer subnet: 10.40.128.0/20).
- BGP: if using dynamic routing, we need remote ASN and BGP neighbor IP. If static, provide precise static routes and next-hop.
- Maintenance window: propose 2026-12-22 02:00-04:00 UTC for low impact; Redwood will apply peering config and run connectivity checks.
- Security: ACL expectation is that ClearSight will allow TCP ports 443 and 443+ for telemetry (we only use HTTPS over 443 for API).

If Mike can confirm ASN and a preferred window, we can book infra and a point engineer. If peering is not possible by 12/22 we should lock IP allowlist by 12/18 and proceed with NAT-only.

-Neha Kapoor
Principal Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference
